scope: Frozen authoritative source metadata only; no analytical brief, hypothesis, result, target threshold, or desired finding.

dataset.title: Bank Marketing
dataset.variant: Original bank-full.csv, all examples; not bank.csv or bank-additional-full.csv.
dataset.source_context: Telephone direct-marketing campaign records for a bank term deposit.
dataset.observation_unit: Original source record; this file has no customer identifier, so unique-customer identity cannot be established from the CSV.
dataset.documentation_precedence: The embedded original dictionary and actual header govern this variant. The current UCI variables table contains some newer-variant names and categories.

missing_conventions.source_statement: Original bank-names.txt reports no missing attribute values.

pdays_sentinel.meaning: Client was not previously contacted by a previous campaign.

missing_conventions.handling: Keep documented unknown categories and the pdays=-1 sentinel verbatim. Neither is an empty cell or an automatic yes/no value.

fields.name: age
fields.meaning: Client age; original documentation labels it numeric.
fields.unit: Age; no explicit unit is stated in the original dictionary.

fields.name: education
fields.meaning: Education category in the original variant.

fields.name: default
fields.meaning: Whether the client has credit in default.

fields.name: housing
fields.meaning: Whether the client has a housing loan.

fields.name: loan
fields.meaning: Whether the client has a personal loan.

fields.name: contact
fields.meaning: Communication type of the last contact in the current campaign.

fields.name: day
fields.meaning: Day of month of the last contact in the current campaign; not day of week.

fields.name: month
fields.meaning: Month of year of the last contact in the current campaign.

fields.name: duration
fields.meaning: Duration of the last contact in the current campaign.

timing.basis: Original bank-names.txt defines last-contact duration. The same-duration definition in official bank-additional-names.txt explicitly states it is unavailable before the call.

fields.name: campaign
fields.meaning: Number of contacts during the current campaign for this client; includes the last contact.

fields.name: pdays
fields.meaning: Days since the client was last contacted by a previous campaign; -1 means no previous contact.

fields.name: previous
fields.meaning: Number of contacts before the current campaign for this client.

fields.name: poutcome
fields.meaning: Outcome of the previous marketing campaign.

fields.name: y
fields.meaning: Whether the client subscribed to a term deposit.

source_limits: No client identifier is provided in this CSV.
The CSV records contact day and month, but not year or a complete timestamp.
The documentation describes historical observational campaign data; the source package makes no causal or current-market claim.
Exact availability times for client attributes are not specified by the source dictionary.
No aggregate results, class counts, correlations, subgroup rankings, recommended thresholds, or analytical answers are included in this contract.
